lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Michael
lines.text:
Little one, the world outside is dangerous.
You must stay here then I can protect you.

lines.speaker: player
lines.name: Cat
options: I can take care of myself well without you.
Get out of my way or I’ll ruffle your wings!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Michael
lines.text:
Order keeps the fragile alive.
I will always be watching you.

lines.speaker: player
lines.name: Cat
options: Then don't stop me from getting stronger.
All you have to do is leave me alone.
Watch if you want. I'll go ahead.
